messages:
Alex: Quick idea 111 1s anyone up for a mini office foosball tourney this Friday 4:30pm? 8 players, single-elim to keep it short. Snacks welcome. :soccer:
Priya: Im in. Can help run bracket and scoreboard. :clipboard:
Miguel: Count me in too. Can we do best-of-3 for semis+final? Otherwise my competitive side files a formal complaint. :grin:
Jenn: Ill bring snacks Bagels or empanadas? React with :bagel: or :taco: to vote.
Sam: Also, who wants to start a tiny fantasy hockey pool this weekend? $10 buy-in, standard scoring, winner gets $70 + custody of the foosball trophy for the month. :hockey_stick_and_puck: :moneybag: :trophy:
Nora: Remote but cheering from afar. Its 2am my side but Ill watch on stream. :zzz::coffee:
Alex: Good call on best-of-3 for later rounds, Miguel. Sam, I like the cross-contest prize idea. Alex: Ill spin up a sign-up sheet and post links here in 15. calendar-bot: Event created: "Foosball + Snacks" Fri 16:30  RSVP requested.
Priya: Bracket layout (copy this):
```
1 vs 8
4 vs 5
3 vs 6
2 vs 7
```
Miguel: If >8 we can do two pods + a final. Rules suggestion: no phone-checking during matches, 1-min break between games, losers get consolation empanadas.
Jenn: Bagels > empanadas but Ill bring both and let people choose. Also bringing wipes. :bagel::taco::+1:
Sam: Fantasy pool: roster lock Sat 11:59pm. Draft order random. Ill post the league link after lunch. React with :moneybag: if youre in and Ill DM Venmo.
Nora: Someone please pin a "photo op" spot so I can later Photoshop myself into the winners' circle. :camera_with_flash: :joy:
Alex: Volunteers for camera/stream? We could angle a laptop or use the GoPro.
Priya: Ill run OBS scene and overlay the bracket sheet. Happy to stream.
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Foosball + Snacks" in 48 hours (Fri 16:30).
Miguel: Sweet. Also can we have a tiny trophy engraving session? Ive got a gold Sharpie. :sparkles:
Jenn: Im putting a small first-aid kit on the table (dramatic high-fives are a hazard). :bandage:
Sam: Pool link will be up in ~90 min. Also considering a consolation $5 raffle for snack items. Thoughts?
Alex: Love the raffle idea. Everyone who loses first match gets a raffle ticket. :ticket:
Priya: Signed up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/foos-signups (fill name + slack handle).
Sam: League link posted: https://fantasy.example/league/abcd. DMing buy-in to those who reacted.
Nora: See you all Friday (virtually) 1. May the best over-caffeinated person win. :coffee:
